name: motely-wasm
description: Balatro seed search + per-seed analysis via JAML. Same Motely engine as native, compiled to WebAssembly (Bootsharp).
author: Nathanial P. Howard

scripts.build: dotnet publish Motely.Wasm.csproj -c Release && node scripts/patch-dist-base64-polyfill.mjs
scripts.build:fs: dotnet publish Motely.Wasm.csproj -c Release -p:EnableFileSystem=true && node scripts/patch-dist-base64-polyfill.mjs
scripts.build:debug: dotnet publish Motely.Wasm.csproj -c Debug && node scripts/patch-dist-base64-polyfill.mjs
scripts.build:debug:fs: dotnet publish Motely.Wasm.csproj -c Debug -p:EnableFileSystem=true && node scripts/patch-dist-base64-polyfill.mjs
